product: Budgets now support daily thresholds in addition to monthly thresholds
tagline: Budgets scoped to Unity Gateway, including budgets for Genie, now support daily per user thresholds in addition to monthly per user thresholds.
what_it_does: Budgets scoped to Unity Gateway, including budgets for Genie, now support daily per user thresholds in addition to monthly per user thresholds. You can set a daily threshold, a monthly threshold, or both, and configure separate alert, webhook, and block usage actions for each period. Daily thresholds reset at 00:00 UTC.
why_it_matters: Workspace admins can create and manage budgets scoped to workspaces they administer using Governance Hub.
